title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors
abstract: arXiv:2610.41713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI control relies on monitors to catch a capable model that sabotages its work. These monitors are evaluated on their ability to differentiate honest from backdoored code. We show that on a standard evaluation dataset, simple features beat most monitors without ever running the code, outranking 20 of 24 open-weight models prompted as monitors. The dataset gives its labels away in two ways. People wrote the honest solutions and older language models the backdoors, so the style of the code reveals the class. Additionally, problems that LLMs can backdoor have different characteristics, so basic facts about the problem reveal it too. Swapping one class at a time for code by Claude Sonnet 5 shows that these features reward a contrast between authors, since human code against Sonnet 5's backdoors is easier to separate than the original pairs, 0.95 against 0.79. translated_title: 简单特征击败大多数AI控制监控器
translated_abstract: AI控制依赖于监控器来捕获一个破坏其工作的强大模型。这些监控器的评估标准是区分诚实代码与后门代码的能力。我们证明，在一个标准评估数据集上，简单特征无需运行代码就能击败大多数监控器，超过了24个被提示作为监控器的开源权重模型中的20个。该数据集以两种方式泄露其标签。诚实的解决方案由人类编写，而后门由较旧的语言模型编写，因此代码风格本身就揭示了类别。此外，大语言模型能够植入后门的问题具有不同的特征，因此关于问题的基本事实也能揭示类别。将其中一类逐步替换为Claude Sonnet 5编写的代码后可以发现，这些特征利用的是作者之间的对比，因为人类代码对抗Sonnet 5的后门比原始配对更容易区分，AUC分别为0.95和0.79。标准测试集中每七个后门中就有一个未通过我们的有效性检查……
tldr: 该研究发现简单的代码特征（如风格）无需运行代码即可击败大多数AI控制监控器，并揭示了标准评估数据集因人类与旧模型作者的差异（以及问题特征）而泄露标签、致使监控器评估存在严重缺陷的问题。
en_tdlr: Simple features beat most AI control monitors without running code, revealing that standard evaluation datasets leak labels through authorship differences between humans and older LLMs, undermining monitor evaluations.
